The release does not identify each defendant’s individual organizational role, separate firearm charges, or a pairwise relationship. Puerto Rico is mapped to broad USA country level as a U.S. territory. Group-level substances are not attributed to individuals. No precise operational sites, tactics, routes, live whereabouts, photos, or inferred links.
